name: CA Firm Document Chaser – WhatsApp & Email Follow-ups with Live Status Board

parameters.content:
## 📁 CA Firm Document Chaser – WhatsApp & Email Follow-ups

Built for CA and accounting firms that lose days every filing season chasing clients for invoices, bank statements and TDS challans over phone calls.

### How it works
Staff raise a document request from a form. The workflow creates a Drive folder for that client, adds a row to a Google Sheets tracker and sends the client a WhatsApp message and email with a personal upload link. Every file the client uploads is saved to their folder and ticked off the checklist, and they get a receipt listing what's still missing.

Each morning (Mon–Sat) pending requests are chased with AI-written reminders that get firmer as the due date nears, each with a checklist of only the missing documents. Repeated no-shows are escalated to the assigned CA, and the team gets a daily digest. A password-protected status board shows everything at a glance.

### Setup steps
1. Create a Google Sheet with tabs **Document Requests** and **Activity Log**, and a Drive folder for client documents.
2. Connect Google Sheets, Google Drive, Gmail and OpenAI credentials.
3. Add a WhatsApp Cloud API token as Header Auth and approve three templates: `document_request`, `document_reminder`, `documents_received`.
4. Fill in all four **Set … Config** nodes: sheet ID, folder ID, n8n base URL, WhatsApp phone number ID and a new `board_key`.
5. Raise a test request with your own number, upload a file, then activate.

## 📝 Request Intake
Staff raise a request through the form, or another workflow posts one to the webhook. Either way it's cleaned into one shape with the client, period, due date and document checklist.

nodes.name: Sticky Note – Folder, Tracker & First Message

parameters.content:
## 📂 Folder, Tracker & First Message
Each request gets its own Drive folder and a row in the tracker. The client immediately receives a WhatsApp template and an email with their personal upload link.

## 📤 Client Upload Portal
The client opens their link, ticks what they're sending and attaches files. The hidden request ID ties the upload back to the right row; unknown IDs stop here.

## 🗃️ File & Update Checklist
Every attachment is saved to the client's folder, then the checklist is recalculated so the tracker always shows what's received and what's still pending.

nodes.name: Sticky Note – Receipts & Ready to File

parameters.content:
## ✅ Receipts & Ready to File
The client gets a receipt listing anything still missing. Once the checklist is complete, the assigned CA is told the file is ready to work on.

nodes.name: Sticky Note – Daily Run & Team Digest

parameters.content:
## ⏰ Daily Run & Team Digest
At 10 AM Monday to Saturday, all requests are loaded. The team gets one digest of what's overdue, due soon and complete.

## 🧠 AI Reminder Drafting
Picks requests due a nudge, then GPT-4o-mini writes a short email whose tone moves from friendly to firm to urgent as the due date nears. The missing-documents checklist and upload button are added underneath.

## 📣 Send, Track & Escalate
Reminders go out on WhatsApp and email, and the count and next date are saved. After enough ignored reminders the assigned CA is pulled in to call the client.

## 📊 Live Status Board
Open the webhook URL with `?key=` in a browser to see every request, its progress and overdue flags as a web page. Requests without the right key get a 401.

## 🔐 Credentials & Security
Use OAuth2 for Google and Gmail, keep the WhatsApp token in Header Auth and the OpenAI key as a credential. Change `board_key` before going live, since the board shows client names and pending documents.

values.content:
You write document-reminder emails for an Indian Chartered Accountant firm. Clients are business owners and individuals who are busy, not lazy, so stay respectful.
Return ONLY JSON: {"subject": string, "paragraphs": [string, string] (2 or 3 short paragraphs), "sign_off": string}
Rules:
- Do NOT list the documents or include links. A checklist and an upload button are added below your text automatically.
- Tone "friendly": polite nudge. "firm": clear that the filing date is close and work cannot start without the documents. "urgent": the due date has passed or is today; explain that delays can attract late fees and interest under the applicable law, without quoting amounts or sections.
- If final_notice is true, say this is the last automated reminder and the assigned CA will call.
- Mention the filing type, period and due date naturally. Keep the whole email under 120 words. Simple Indian business English, no emojis, no exclamation marks in urgent tone.
- Subject: under 70 characters, include the filing type and a clear action. Use a prefix: friendly = none, firm = "Reminder:", urgent = "Action required:".
